name: Asahina Louis
source:
Birth Date: 1989/02/22.

Louis is the 8th son of the Asahina family. He works as a hairdresser. He is a beautiful and mysterious man, always looking up at the clouds. He is the only other person beside [url=/c10574]Ema[/url] who can communicate with [url=/c10575]Juli[/url] and promises him that they will protect Ema. 

[spoiler]It is later revealed in the game and anime that he is adopted, and he is the one who helps Ema after she finds out she is adopted as well.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_Conflict#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
